svg.desc: A YAML config file — window bar, key squares and value lines — under a magnifying glass, with two warning triangles beside coerced boolean lines and a crossed-out error marker on a duplicate key. Trace Bloom generative banner for “yamllint: the honest review”. A quantized lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2909325218.
